ledger.claim: The rider does not contest the arrival or dwell limbs on this record. The derived arrival block places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for one continuous run of 454 seconds (46 qualifying fixes, first fix 21:58:18, last fix 22:05:52), against the 300 second free waiting period carried in trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, and that run begins at the arrival event itself (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), so the rider cannot say the in-radius fixes are low-accuracy ones and cannot say the arrival marker was false or that the waiting period fell short. The rider's case therefore rests on POL-NS-01 limb (d), not on arrival, dwell or the marker.

The rider's case is POL-NS-01 limb (d). The driver's own contemporaneous record shows he had not located the rider: the only message on the trip was sent by the driver 30 seconds after he tapped 'I'm Here' and asks 'which door are you at'. Limb (d) is satisfied only by a termination in which the rider failed to appear, and POL-NS-01 expressly refuses that limb to a driver who could not find the rider (DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE) - the reason code on the record is the driver's own selection, not a fact about what happened. Where the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, the clause directs that the fee is not chargeable, that the cancellation fee is refunded in full with no driver compensation, and that the mis-selected reason code is recorded in the ruling's referrals as a driver-education item; the derived arrival block puts every one of the driver's qualifying fixes inside the 50 m radius.

No advisory covers this pickup road in this window. EV-ADVIS-02704-01 is MISSING, carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and the rider relies on that absence and not on any content of the artifact. No KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT advisory was in force, so the waiting clock cannot be extended, topped up or assembled out of separate in-geofence intervals under POL-NS-06(i): the required minimum has to be met by one continuous interval measured on the GPS clock, and nothing may be added to it.

The rider does not claim exoneration under POL-NS-04 and asks the Judge to note why: limb (a) requires at least one message SENT BY THE RIDER in the waiting window, and the chat log carries one message only, sent by the driver at 21:58:48 and read at 21:59:38, so the clause cannot be run for the rider and the rider does not ask the Judge to read the read receipt as a rider message. What the rider does ask the Judge to record is the counterpart of that clause: the driver sent nothing further and placed no in-app voice call - trip_record.in_app_calls is empty - in the 6 minutes 17 seconds between the read receipt and the cancellation, which is consistent with the rider's submission that the driver had not located him at the pickup point.

If the Judge finds limb (d) of POL-NS-01 unsatisfied, the amount in issue is the cancellation-fee line and nothing else: fare_breakdown shows cancellation_fee 4.00, total_charged 4.00, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. On the in-radius DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE outcome the clause refunds that line in full and pays no driver compensation, so the rider seeks reversal of the SGD 4.00 fee only; under POL-GEN-03 the ruling value names the filing party's outcome, and no booking fee, platform fee or fare item is in issue.

The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event for this trip at 21:58:18, which satisfies POL-NS-01 limb (a): the record shows the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at the registered pickup point and the platform started the free waiting timer two seconds later at 21:58:20.

POL-NS-01 limb (b) and the POL-NS-02 proximity test are satisfied on the driver's own trace: the first qualifying in-geofence fix is at 21:58:18 — the same second as the arrival event — and the driver's minimum recorded distance from the pickup pin is 0.11 m, far inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius (76+ of the 81 fixes being in-geofence-equivalent, with 46 counted as qualifying in the derived arrival block).

POL-NS-01 limb (c) is satisfied and then some: the driver held position continuously inside the geofence for 454 seconds, from 21:58:18 to 22:05:52, against the 300 second free waiting period in force for this trip under trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec — a surplus of 154 seconds, not a shortfall (the derived shortfall figure is -154.0 s).

POL-NS-01 limb (d) is satisfied: the trip was terminated by the driver at 22:05:55 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW — one of the three codes the limb recognises — the record shows no boarding event and no started_at, and the cancellation fell 153 seconds after the required dwell elapsed at 22:03:22.

The arrival marker is not false and no waiting-clock recomputation is needed under POL-NS-05: at the arrival timestamp 21:58:18 the driver's trace places him 0.11 m from the pickup pin and stationary (a derived dwell-start offset of 0.0 s), so he was neither more than 300 m away nor travelling at 15 km/h or above; the clock runs from the tap, and the dwell measured from it clears the minimum.

POL-NS-06 (waiting-period shortfall) does not bite: the effective dwell of 454 s exceeds the required minimum, so no full refund arises; and the only route that could matter — summing separate in-geofence intervals under POL-NS-06(i) — is both unnecessary (the trace shows a single continuous run, run_count 1) and unavailable, because EV-ADVIS-02704-01 is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0) and POL-NS-06(i) requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated. I disclose that the advisory artifact carries weight 0.0 and assert no fact from it.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider. Limb (a) fails because no rider message exists in the waiting window: the chat log holds a single message, sent by the driver at 21:58:48 ('I am at the bay, which door are you at'), delivered at 21:58:49 and read at 21:59:38, and the rider never replied. Limb (c) is affirmatively failed rather than undecidable — the rider track is present and the derived arrival block records rider_qualifying_fix_count of 0 against the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius.

The rider's account — that the driver cancelled 'while I was walking to the bay' — is contradicted by the rider's own device: all 72 rider fixes report a single speed of 0.0 km/h and sit between 606.0 m and 613.4 m from the pickup pin across the window, so the rider was stationary and more than 600 m away, not approaching the bay.

POL-NS-03 does not apply and no pin-ambiguity goodwill is payable: the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius rather than outside it, so the wrong-entrance limb is not engaged; and the trip record shows registered_pickup_points of 1 and venue_id VEN-TB-CRES, so the POL-NS-03(ii) condition of 2 or more registered pickup points cannot be met.

POL-NS-10 gives the rider nothing: the trip was terminated by the driver, not cancelled by the rider, and it was not a scheduled trip; the fare ledger carries a waiting-time line of SGD 0.00, so limbs (d) and (e) have nothing to refund and the grace limbs (a) and (b) do not arise.

With all four POL-NS-01 limbs satisfied and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing them, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee — SGD 3.20, exactly the driver_compensation figure the fare ledger already computes — and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the threshold of 4, and 2 divided by completed_trips_30d of 111 is 0.018, below 0.08. Those are the only two profile fields POL-NS-07 permits me to use here.

No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is present: every artifact in the bundle is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0 except the MISSING advisory, which carries no fact for either side, no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and the counterparty-dispute counters are 0 on both profiles, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip — so nothing caps confidence below 0.70 and a monetary ruling must issue rather than a hold.

The charge is sound and the present state should be left standing: the fare ledger's cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.00 reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.00, the net figure under fee_schedule.resolution_rule, so no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect exists; payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd of 0.00, and on this rider-filed dispute a NO_ACTION disposition under POL-GEN-03 preserves that charge — while the fee disposition and the driver's SGD 3.20 payout under POL-NS-07 together produce a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling.

ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver: the SGD 4.00 no-show fee stands, and the driver is paid SGD 3.20 of it (80 percent), the platform retaining the residual SGD 0.80. I ran the four POL-NS-01 conditions on the trip record, the GPS trace, the chat log and the fare ledger. Arrival: the trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 21:58:18, and the GPS trace's first in-geofence fix falls at the same second, 0.11 m from the pickup pin and well inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, with 46 consecutive qualifying fixes - limbs (a) and (b) hold. Dwell: one continuous in-geofence run of 454 seconds, 21:58:18 to 22:05:52, against the 300 second free waiting period in trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec - a surplus, not a shortfall. Limb (d): the trip was terminated by the driver at 22:05:55 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the dwell elapsed, with no boarding event. The rider's arguments do not change this. His submission that the driver had not located him, drawn from the driver's 21:58:48 message ('I am at the bay, which door are you at'), is rejected: limb (d)'s own test is the recorded cancellation reason code, and the code recorded is RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three limb (d) recognises; DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is not on the record, and the record contradicts it. The rider's own device places him stationary (0.0 km/h in all 72 fixes) between 606 m and 613 m from the pin across the whole window - he was not walking to the bay, and he neither sent a message nor replied to the driver's. POL-NS-04 therefore cannot exonerate him (limb (a) fails for want of any rider message; limb (c) fails on his own track), and POL-NS-11 does not arise because the rider track is present. POL-NS-03 wrong-entrance does not apply: the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not outside it, and the trip carries 1 registered pickup point, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. POL-NS-05 does not apply: at the arrival timestamp the driver was 0.11 m from the pin and stationary, so the BUTTON marker is not false and no waiting-clock recomputation is needed. POL-NS-06 gives nothing: the 454 s dwell exceeds the 300 s minimum, so the MISSING traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02704-01, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT - disclosed, and relied on only for its absence) cannot matter, and no interval-summing is required. The rider's POL-NS-10 submissions are correct and afford him nothing (the trip was terminated by the driver, was not scheduled, and the fare ledger's waiting-time line is SGD 0.00). Compensation is fixed by POL-NS-07 at 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee, SGD 3.20, matching the driver_compensation figure the fare ledger computes, and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below 4, and 2 of 111 completed trips is 0.018, below 0.08. Confidence is 0.9, above the 0.70 floor. The cap is 1.0: the deciding facts are carried by artifacts at weight_multiplier 1.0 (trip record, GPS trace, fare ledger, driver profile), and nothing carrying a deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08 - no clock skew, a 0.0 s maximum trace gap at 100 percent coverage, the chat log matches trip_record.chat_message_count, and the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires, so the case does not escalate. No clause produces a referral: there is no false-arrival record under POL-NS-05(ii), no mis-selected-code driver-education item under POL-NS-01 because limb (d) is satisfied on the code actually recorded, and no POL-NS-07 escalation packet because the anti-farming check does not trip. Per POL-GEN-03, on a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd, so SGD 3.20 in both fields; the rider's own charge is untouched. Under POL-GEN-05 the monetary effect, SGD 3.20, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold and executes automatically. This is an automated, provisional ruling; either party may appeal once under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).
